detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Ipamorelin

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C38H49N9O5
  • Molecular Weight: 711.86 g/mol
  • Sequence: Aib-His-D-2-Nal-D-Phe-Lys-NH2
  • Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

Ipamorelin is a synthetic peptide classified within the growth hormone secretagogue (GHS) class of compounds. It is utilized in laboratory research involving peptide structure and interaction analysis under controlled experimental conditions. This material is supplied in lyophilized powder form and is intended strictly for in vitro research and analytical applications. It supports investigation of molecular systems in non-clinical experimental environments.

Research Applications:

In controlled laboratory research settings, Ipamorelin is utilized in the study of:

  • Peptide-receptor interaction modeling involving growth hormone secretagogue receptors (GHS-R) in isolated cell-based or cell-free in vitro assay systems
  • Ligand binding dynamics in peptide-based systems
  • Analysis of intracellular signaling pathways in in vitro experimental models
  • Structure–activity relationship studies of synthetic peptide analogs
  • Assay development and receptor-binding investigations under controlled conditions

All research applications are conducted in non-human, non-clinical experimental settings.

Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized material at −20°C (−4°F)
  • After reconstitution, store at 2–8°C (36–46°F) and use promptly
  • Avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles
  • Handle according to institutional protocols for non-sterile research materials
  • Maintain aseptic techniques during laboratory handling

Product Specifications:

  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

Ipamorelin is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
